### 1. Technical Environment
code_version: 187f98075cd11016108c751f8e0296e7b79668a0

### 2. Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior
ensure_lambda_function should create a Lambda function with a placeholder code package; aws-deploy-handler.sh subsequently updates the function with real handler code.

#### Actual Behavior
Line 324: '--zip-file "fileb:///dev/null"' — AWS CLI rejects with 'ParamValidation: --zip-file must be a zip file with the fileb:// prefix'. /dev/null is not a valid zip archive. The create-function call fails immediately on attempt 1 (and would fail every retry).

After this failure, IAM role + log group ARE created in AWS (partial state), so re-runs after fix should be idempotent.

Impact: blocks 73d7-1968 closure; aws-setup-lambda.sh cannot create the Lambda function via the documented setup sequence.

#### Suggested Fix
Replace the /dev/null hack with a temporary empty-zip file:
  local zip_tmp; zip_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/dso-lambda-placeholder.XXXXXX.zip)
  python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('$zip_tmp','w').close()"
  ...create-function --zip-file fileb://$zip_tmp...
  trap 'rm -f $zip_tmp' EXIT

This creates a valid empty zip placeholder; aws-deploy-handler.sh overwrites it later with the real handler payload.
data.title: [aws-setup-lambda.sh]: create-function uses --zip-file fileb:///dev/null which AWS rejects with ParamValidation
